name: Direct Volume Rendering with Interactive Piecewise Transfer Function
aliases: Front-to-Back Ray Casting with Transfer Functions
definition: A CPU-based direct volume rendering technique that maps scalar voxel values to RGBA colors using a piecewise linear transfer function defined by 5 control points, then composites the resulting 3D volume along rays using front-to-back alpha blending.
summary: This CPU-based technique maps voxel values to RGBA using a piecewise transfer function, then composites the result via front-to-back alpha blending along slices.
